googleBrokerSettings.s_setup-intro.title: Setup
googleBrokerSettings.s_setup-intro.descr: Google Cloud Console — register the hub redirect before Add / Sign in.
googleBrokerSettings.s_google-oauth-clie: Web application client from Google Cloud Console. The same Cloud project can be reused across Google brokers.
googleBrokerSettings.s_gmail-send.title: Gmail send
googleBrokerSettings.s_gmail-send.descri: From must be this connected account or a verified send-as. Disable Email on Connectivity to turn Gmail off without removing the broker.
googleBrokerSettings.s_gmail-send.fromAd: Defaults to the connected Google account email when empty.
googleFeatureSettings.s_google-calendars: Nothing selected = no calendars imported. Options appear after at least one Google broker is signed in.
Ids are stamped as brokerId:googleCalendarId across every Google broker.
